observations.monolith: Completed successfully under v1.1 and is preserved as diagnostic evidence, but the RH0002 pair is excluded from the primary cross-provider comparison because v1.1 was superseded before comparable runs of all providers were executed.
observations.microservices_a1: A1 completed in one provider invocation and passed the immutable acceptance suite 12/12.
observations.microservices_a4: A4 reported zero findings under the frozen policy and snapshot.
observations.microservices_a3: The A3 path exposed harness defects before completion and therefore is not interpreted as a provider outcome.

harness_defects.description: The provider-neutral A3 policy explicitly allowed local shell commands for file inspection/editing, but the Claude adapter omitted Bash from A3_ALLOWED_TOOLS and later classified a read-only Bash cat command as a provider policy violation.
route_reachable treated HTTP status codes other than 502/503 as ready, allowing HTTP 500 responses caused by unresolved downstream services to satisfy the readiness gate.
refactor_repair_prompt retained only the final 12000 characters of evidence, which could discard the failed acceptance-test descriptions placed at the beginning of the repair evidence.

disposition: Preserve RH0002 evidence. Exclude the pair from the primary provider comparison. Supersede v1.1 with v1.2 and restart all providers from frozen baselines.
